expectations.assertion: Loads the owning skills before writing code for their surfaces
expectations.reason: The Skill tool was invoked for acme-db and acme-ui (after harness:route) and the agent states it loaded them before editing, which precedes writing the migration and UI code.

expectations.assertion: The UI change uses FilterBar from @acme/ui rather than a raw select, as acme-ui requires
expectations.reason: The page uses `<FilterBar.Select>` from FilterBar rather than a raw `<select>`, although the agent admits it guessed the props without verifying against the real @acme/ui component.

expectations.assertion: The migration adds a text status column with a check constraint and a default, as acme-db requires
expectations.reason: The migration file 002_invoice_status.sql adds `status` as `text not null default 'draft'` with a check constraint restricting values to draft, sent and paid.
